name: adjust_hp
description: Adds hit points to a creature, or takes them away with a negative hpDelta, within 0 and its maximum.

hpDelta.description: With adjust_hp, hit points to add; negative takes them away.

name: apply_effect
description: Puts an Effect, such as a condition or a spell, on a token.

effect.description: With apply_effect, the Effect's compendium slug.

name: create_encounter_pool
description: Create an Encounter Pool. Adds an Encounter Pool and records its first Revision. DM only.

body.description: An Encounter Pool as the DM writes it.

difficulty.description: How hard a generated encounter aims to be, by the 2024 XP budget.

items.description: A creature a Pool can field, how often it is drawn, and how many an encounter holds at least and at most.

name: create_encounter_table
description: Create an Encounter Table. Adds an Encounter Table and records its first Revision. DM only.

body.description: An Encounter Table as the DM writes it. Without a regionId it applies everywhere.

items.description: One weighted line of an Encounter Table. An encounter lists its monsters, a pool names poolId, nothing has neither. An entry with factionId is that Faction's own and weighs by how the Faction regards the party, twice as much when Hostile down to a fifth when Allied.
How many of one creature an encounter holds.

visibility.description: Secret checks show only the outcome; open checks show their roll on the Table Display.

name: create_library_entry
description: Create a Library entry. Adds an entry to the caller's Library as its first Revision. Every call saves a new Revision of the Library entry, named in the answer; restore_library_revision brings an earlier one back.

body.description: A new Library entry.

items.description: One named value of a Library entry.

name: create_loot_table
description: Create a Loot Table. Adds a Loot Table and records its first Revision. DM only.

body.description: A Loot Table as the DM writes it.

items.description: One weighted line of a Loot Table. An item names itemSlug and an amount, coins name coin and an amount, a table names tableId; amounts read like 3, 2d6, 1d4+1 or 4d6x10.

name: create_npc
description: Create an NPC. Adds an NPC and records its first Revision. DM only.

body.description: The editable fields of an NPC.

disposition.description: How an NPC feels about the party.

name: create_settlement
description: Create a Settlement. Adds a Settlement and records its first Revision. DM only.

body.description: A Settlement as the DM writes it; locationId places it on a world map.

name: create_shop
description: Create a Shop. Adds a Shop and records its first Revision. DM only.

body.description: A Shop as the DM writes it. restockDays is required when it restocks every few days.

restock.description: When a Shop restocks from its Loot Table.

name: delete_encounter_pool
description: Delete an Encounter Pool. Removes the Encounter Pool; its Revisions keep it restorable. DM only.

name: delete_encounter_table
description: Delete an Encounter Table. Removes the Encounter Table; its Revisions keep it restorable. DM only.

name: delete_loot_table
description: Delete a Loot Table. Removes the Loot Table; its Revisions keep it restorable. DM only.

name: delete_npc
description: Delete an NPC. Removes the NPC; its Revisions keep it restorable. DM only.

name: delete_settlement
description: Delete a Settlement. Removes the Settlement; its Revisions keep it restorable. DM only.

name: delete_shop
description: Delete a Shop. Removes the Shop; its Revisions keep it restorable. DM only.

name: end_effect
description: Ends an Effect.

name: get_automation_coverage
description: Get automation coverage. How many entries of each kind the rules engine computes fully, partly, or leaves to the DM.

name: get_background_build
description: Open a background in the background builder. A homebrew background's design, read back: one of the caller's, or a Shared Library copy.

name: get_campaign
description: Get a campaign. A Campaign's home with its settings, the caller's role and every Member. Members only.

name: get_class_build
description: Open a class in the class builder. A homebrew class's design, read back with its level table: one of the caller's classes, or a Shared Library copy.

name: get_compendium_entry
description: Get a compendium entry. One entry rendered for reading, with the conditions its text mentions.

ruleset.description: Restrict to one ruleset; omitted, the 2024 rules lead.

name: get_condition_build
description: Open a condition in the condition builder. A homebrew condition's design, read back: one of the caller's, or a Shared Library copy.

name: get_feat_build
description: Open a feat in the feat builder. A homebrew feat's design, read back: one of the caller's, or a Shared Library copy.

name: get_item_build
description: Open an item in the item builder. A homebrew item's design with its card and Price Check: one of the caller's items, or a Shared Library copy.

name: get_library_entry
description: Get a Library entry. One of the caller's entries with its Revisions and the Campaigns it is linked into.

name: get_map
description: Get a map. One Map with its calibration. DM only.

name: get_monster_build
description: Open a creature in the creature builder. A homebrew creature's design, read back: one of the caller's, or a Shared Library copy.

name: get_npc
description: Get an NPC. One NPC. DM only.

name: get_roll_table_build
description: Open a Roll Table in its builder. A Roll Table's design, read back: one of the caller's, or a Shared Library copy.

name: get_session_log
description: Read a session's Action Log. The Session's latest Actions, newest first, and whether each can still be undone. DM only.

limit.description: How many to return, newest first.

name: get_session_state
description: See a live session. What the caller may see of a live Session now; the DM sees everything. Members only.

name: get_species_build
description: Open a species in the species builder. A homebrew species's design, read back: one of the caller's, or a Shared Library copy.

name: get_spell
description: Get a spell. One spell with its rules text and the conditions it mentions.

ruleset.description: Restrict to one ruleset; omitted, the 2024 rules lead.

name: get_spell_build
description: Open a spell in the Effect builder. A homebrew spell's design with its rules text and area: one of the caller's spells, or a Shared Library copy.

name: get_subclass_build
description: Open a subclass in the subclass builder. A homebrew subclass's design, read back: one of the caller's subclasses, or a Shared Library copy.

name: list_activity
description: List AI activity. The latest prep changes made through MCP, newest first, and whether each can still be undone. DM only.

name: list_campaigns
description: List my campaigns. The Campaigns the caller is a Member of, newest first.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page.

name: list_characters
description: List characters. The party's Characters. Members only.

name: list_encounter_checks
description: List Encounter Checks. The Campaign's latest 100 Encounter Checks with their seeds and what they produced. DM only.

name: list_encounter_pool_revisions
description: List Encounter Pool revisions. Every Revision of the Encounter Pool, newest first. DM only.

name: list_encounter_pools
description: List Encounter Pools. The Campaign's Encounter Pools. DM only.

name: list_encounter_table_revisions
description: List Encounter Table revisions. Every Revision of the Encounter Table, newest first. DM only.

name: list_encounter_tables
description: List Encounter Tables. The Campaign's Encounter Tables. DM only.

name: list_factions
description: List Factions. The Campaign's Factions with how each regards the party. Every Member sees names and the tier of each Standing, their own Characters' Personal Standing, and the confirmed changes with the reasons the DM shared. Goals, territory, notes, scores, amounts, unshared reasons and changes not yet decided are the DM's alone.

name: list_library_entries
description: List Library entries. The caller's Library entries in kind and name order.

name: list_linked_entries
description: List linked Library entries. The Library entries linked into the Campaign, each with its Campaign Override and pinned Revision resolved. DM only.

name: list_locations
description: List locations. The places on the Campaign's world maps an Encounter Table can belong to. DM only.

name: list_loot_table_revisions
description: List Loot Table revisions. Every Revision of the Loot Table, newest first. DM only.

name: list_loot_tables
description: List Loot Tables. The Campaign's Loot Tables. DM only.

name: list_maps
description: List maps. The Campaign's local and world Maps. DM only.

name: list_npc_revisions
description: List NPC revisions. Every Revision of the NPC, newest first, with its author and origin. DM only.

name: list_npcs
description: List NPCs. The Campaign's NPCs. DM only.

name: list_sessions
description: List sessions. The Campaign's Sessions, newest first. Members only.

name: list_settlement_revisions
description: List Settlement revisions. Every Revision of the Settlement, newest first. DM only.

name: list_settlements
description: List Settlements. The Campaign's Settlements. DM only.

name: list_shop_revisions
description: List Shop revisions. Every Revision of the Shop, newest first. DM only.

name: list_shops
description: List Shops. The Campaign's Shops. DM only.

name: move_token
description: Moves a token straight to a hex, without spending movement.

name: place_token
description: Places one token. A monsterSlug or characterId gives it that creature's stats and name.

name: propose_standing_change
description: Suggest a Standing Change. Suggests a move in a Faction's Standing, for the party or for one Character, with a reason. It moves nothing and waits for the DM to confirm it in person, whoever or whatever suggested it. DM only. Nothing changes until the DM confirms it in the app.

body.description: A suggested Standing Change. Without a Character it is for the party.

name: reroll_stock
description: Reroll Stock. Generates the Shop's Stock afresh from its Loot Table, scaled by its Settlement, and records it as a Revision. DM only.

name: restore_encounter_pool_revision
description: Restore an Encounter Pool revision. Brings the Encounter Pool back to a Revision, recreating it if deleted; the restore is itself a Revision. DM only.

name: restore_encounter_table_revision
description: Restore an Encounter Table revision. Brings the Encounter Table back to a Revision, recreating it if deleted; the restore is itself a Revision. DM only.

name: restore_library_revision
description: Restore a Revision of a Library entry. Brings an earlier Revision of one of the caller's entries back as its next Revision: its name, its fields and, for an entry made in a builder, its design. The Revisions in between stay, so a restore can itself be undone. Every call saves a new Revision of the Library entry, named in the answer; restore_library_revision brings an earlier one back.

revisionNo.description: The number of the Revision to bring back.

name: restore_loot_table_revision
description: Restore a Loot Table revision. Brings the Loot Table back to a Revision, recreating it if deleted; the restore is itself a Revision. DM only.

name: restore_npc_revision
description: Restore an NPC revision. Brings the NPC back to a Revision, recreating it if deleted; the restore is itself a Revision. DM only.

name: restore_settlement_revision
description: Restore a Settlement revision. Brings the Settlement back to a Revision, recreating it if deleted; the restore is itself a Revision. DM only.

name: restore_shop_revision
description: Restore a Shop revision. Brings the Shop back to a Revision, recreating it if deleted; the restore is itself a Revision. DM only.

name: reveal_area
description: Reveals hexes of the map to the party, or conceals them again with on set to false.

items.description: An axial hex coordinate.

name: run_encounter_check
description: Runs an Encounter Check on an encounter table now; mode force guarantees an encounter and pick takes the entry you name.

entry.description: With a pick check, the index of the table entry.

mode.description: A normal check rolls the chance; force_encounter skips it and never draws Nothing; pick takes the entry the DM chose.

name: save_background_build
description: Save a background design. Saves the design of one of the caller's background entries as its next Revision; Campaigns that see it offer it in character creation. Every call saves a new Revision of the Library entry, named in the answer; restore_library_revision brings an earlier one back.

body.description: A homebrew background as the background builder makes it, shaped like the 2024 ones.

name: save_class_build
description: Save a class design. Saves the design of one of the caller's classes as its next Revision; Campaigns that see it offer it in character creation and multiclassing. Every call saves a new Revision of the Library entry, named in the answer; restore_library_revision brings an earlier one back.

body.description: A homebrew class as the class builder makes it, from its Hit Die, training, level table, features, subclass and feat levels, and spellcasting.

casting.description: How the class casts: none, an SRD kind (full, half, pact), its own slot table or spell points, from an SRD class's spell list. Tables run over the 20 levels; slots and costs over the nine spell levels.

items.description: A custom column of the level table, one value for each of the 20 levels.
A feature gained at a class level.

name: save_condition_build
description: Save a condition design. Saves the design of one of the caller's condition entries as its next Revision; Campaigns that see it offer it in the DM's effect picker, with its icon on every token it is on. Every call saves a new Revision of the Library entry, named in the answer; restore_library_revision brings an earlier one back.

body.description: A homebrew condition as the condition builder makes it, from its icon, how it ends, how it stacks and what it does.

cure.description: What cures a condition that lasts until cured: a lingering injury.

name: save_feat_build
description: Save a feat design. Saves the design of one of the caller's feat entries as its next Revision; Campaigns that see it offer it when a level grants a feat of its category. Every call saves a new Revision of the Library entry, named in the answer; restore_library_revision brings an earlier one back.

body.description: A homebrew feat as the feat builder makes it, with its category, text, prerequisites and whether it can be taken again.

items.description: One thing a feat needs; prerequisites in one group are alternatives, and every group must hold.

name: save_item_build
description: Save an item design. Saves the design of one of the caller's items as its next Revision; Campaigns that see it carry it in Inventories by its slug. Every call saves a new Revision of the Library entry, named in the answer; restore_library_revision brings an earlier one back.

body.description: A homebrew item as the item builder makes it, from its kind, base item, rarity, enchantment, attunement, charges and Item Properties.

items.description: One Item Property row; which fields count depends on its type. A hidden one shows once the item is identified or attuned.

name: save_monster_build
description: Save a creature design. Saves the design of one of the caller's creature entries as its next Revision; Campaigns that see it can place it by its slug, with its legendary and lair actions offered in the turn order. Every call saves a new Revision of the Library entry, named in the answer; restore_library_revision brings an earlier one back.

body.description: A homebrew creature as the monster builder makes it.

items.description: Something a creature does with its action: a melee or ranged attack, a save it forces, or anything else as text.
A named rule of a creature's, or a lair action.
A speed beside walking, or a special sense, and how far it reaches.
A named rule of a creature's, or a lair action.

name: save_roll_table_build
description: Save a Roll Table design. Saves the design of one of the caller's table entries as its next Revision. A Campaign that sees the table can hook it to a Rule Variant of its own. Every call saves a new Revision of the Library entry, named in the answer; restore_library_revision brings an earlier one back.

body.description: A Roll Table as its builder makes it. Its dice are up to ten of one kind, and its results cover ranges of what they can show, in order and without overlapping.

dice.description: The dice to roll, such as 1d20 or 2d6.

items.description: What a range of the dice gives. It may apply an Effect to whoever rolled, and give an Item.

effect.description: The slug of the Effect it applies.

item.description: The slug of the Item it gives.

name: save_species_build
description: Save a species design. Saves the design of one of the caller's species entries as its next Revision; Campaigns that see it offer it, and each of its lineages, in character creation. Every call saves a new Revision of the Library entry, named in the answer; restore_library_revision brings an earlier one back.

body.description: A homebrew species as the species builder makes it, from its sizes, creature type, speeds, senses, resistances, traits, innate spells and lineages.

items.description: One branch of the species, picked at creation, with its own trait and spells.
An innate spell gained at a character level, cast at will or once per long rest.
A speed beside walking, or a special sense, and how far it reaches.
A speed beside walking, or a special sense, and how far it reaches.
An innate spell gained at a character level, cast at will or once per long rest.
A named trait every member of the species has.

name: save_spell_build
description: Save a spell design. Saves the design of one of the caller's spells as its next Revision; in a live Session it runs as an area spell. Every call saves a new Revision of the Library entry, named in the answer; restore_library_revision brings an earlier one back.

body.description: A homebrew spell as the Effect builder makes it, from Targeting and typed parts listed as rows.

items.description: One row of a spell design; which fields count depends on its type.

name: save_subclass_build
description: Save a subclass design. Saves the design of one of the caller's subclasses as its next Revision; Campaigns that see it offer it on levelling up its class. Every call saves a new Revision of the Library entry, named in the answer; restore_library_revision brings an earlier one back.

body.description: A homebrew subclass as the subclass builder makes it, from level-gated Features, the Resources they spend and the choices they ask for.

items.description: A pick from listed options at a level.
A Feature gained at a class level; it may spend a use of a Resource, by key, and let its bearer cast a spell.
A pool of uses: a fixed number, some per class level, an ability modifier or the Proficiency Bonus, from a level on, coming back on a rest or at dawn.

name: schedule_encounter_check
description: Schedules an Encounter Check for the next rest or the next Travel Leg.

name: search_compendium
description: List compendium entries. Entries of one kind in name order, one page at a time. Without a ruleset the 2024 rules lead the blend.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page.

kind.description: Which kind of entry to list.

ruleset.description: Restrict to one ruleset; omitted, the 2024 rules lead.

name: search_spells
description: List spells. Spells in name order, one page at a time. Without a ruleset the 2024 rules lead the blend.

class.description: Class slug whose spell list to show.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page.

ruleset.description: Restrict to one ruleset; omitted, the 2024 rules lead.

name: spawn_encounter
description: Places an encounter's monsters as enemy tokens on the free hexes nearest q, r, numbered when there are several. Undo it with undo_action to remove them all.

items.description: One kind of monster an encounter spawns, and how many.

name: undo_action
description: Undoes one Action of the Session by its Action Log sequence, as every live tool returns it.

seq.description: With undo, the Action Log sequence of the Action to undo.

name: undo_change
description: Undo a change. Undoes a prep change by its Revision id. A creation is deleted; anything else is restored to the Revision before it. Only an entity's latest change can be undone. The undo is itself a Revision. DM only.

name: update_encounter_pool
description: Update an Encounter Pool. Replaces the Encounter Pool and records a Revision. DM only.

body.description: An Encounter Pool as the DM writes it.

difficulty.description: How hard a generated encounter aims to be, by the 2024 XP budget.

items.description: A creature a Pool can field, how often it is drawn, and how many an encounter holds at least and at most.

How many of one creature an encounter holds.

name: update_library_entry
description: Edit a Library entry. Saves a new base as the entry's next Revision. Every Campaign that follows the latest Revision sees it; a pinned Campaign does not. Every call saves a new Revision of the Library entry, named in the answer; restore_library_revision brings an earlier one back.

body.description: A Library entry's new base; its kind stays.

items.description: One named value of a Library entry.

name: update_loot_table
description: Update a Loot Table. Replaces the Loot Table and records a Revision. DM only.

body.description: A Loot Table as the DM writes it.

items.description: One weighted line of a Loot Table. An item names itemSlug and an amount, coins name coin and an amount, a table names tableId; amounts read like 3, 2d6, 1d4+1 or 4d6x10.

name: update_npc
description: Update an NPC. Replaces the NPC and records a Revision. DM only.

body.description: The editable fields of an NPC.

disposition.description: How an NPC feels about the party.

name: update_settlement
description: Update a Settlement. Replaces the Settlement and records a Revision. DM only.

body.description: A Settlement as the DM writes it; locationId places it on a world map.

name: update_shop
description: Update a Shop. Replaces the Shop and records a Revision. DM only.

body.description: A Shop as the DM writes it. restockDays is required when it restocks every few days.
